mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacherName FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacherName FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacherName FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.semester DESC
SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacherName FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%') AND c.status = 1
SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacherName FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.semester = #{semester} AND c.status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (course_code, course_name, credit, semester, teacher_id, status) VALUES (#{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{credit}, #{semester}, #{teacherId}, #{status})
